pages.title: Cat Urine Bottle
pages.text: Blood Meal requires a $(bold)Cat Urine Bottle$() — here's how to get one:$(br)$(br)1. Find a $(bold)Cat$() (spawns in villages)$(br)2. Hold a $(bold)Glass Bottle$() in your hand$(br)3. $(bold)Right-click$() the cat$(br)$(br)The cat will fill your bottle! Each cat has a $(bold)5 minute cooldown$() before it can be collected from again. Keep a few cats around for a steady supply.
